name: Lexware Office
description: Lexware Office (formerly lexoffice) — Germany's most-used SMB bookkeeping app. Read and create contacts, invoices, quotations, delivery notes and articles, read credit notes, vouchers and document PDFs, and pull the voucher list that drives the Buchhaltung. Public REST API v1, bearer token.
instructions:
**Getting a token**
1. Sign in to Lexware Office (lexoffice) with an account on a paid plan — the API is not available on the free tier.
2. Open **Einstellungen → Erweiterungen → Öffentliche API** and create a new access token. The token is shown once; store it immediately.
3. Set `LEXWARE_API_KEY` to that value. It is a personal token scoped to the one company (Mandant) it was created in; a tax adviser handling several clients needs one connector per client.

**API version**: this adapter targets the public REST API **v1** at `https://api.lexware.io/v1`. Lexware still serves the historical `api.lexoffice.io` host; both answer the same tokens, but new integrations should use `api.lexware.io`.

**Rate limit**: 2 requests per second per token. The API answers a burst with `429`; the agent should pace bulk work rather than retry in a tight loop.

**Vouchers vs invoices**: `lexware_office_list_vouchers` reads the *voucher list* — the bookkeeping view that contains sales invoices, purchase invoices, credit notes and receipts alike, and is what you want for "what is unpaid". `lexware_office_get_invoice` reads a single sales invoice document with its line items.

**Writes**: `lexware_office_create_contact` and `lexware_office_create_invoice` create real records in the live company. `lexware_office_create_delivery_note` and `lexware_office_create_quotation_draft` create drafts only (nothing is sent or booked). `lexware_office_create_article` and `lexware_office_update_article` change the product catalogue; an update replaces the whole article, so read it first and send its current `version`. An invoice created with `finalize: false` stays a draft (Entwurf) and can still be deleted in the UI; finalized invoices are legally immutable under GoBD and can only be corrected with a credit note.

**PDFs**: `lexware_office_get_invoice_pdf` and `lexware_office_get_delivery_note_pdf` return the document as a file, for finalized documents only (a draft answers 409).

**Cloud reachability**: api.lexware.io is public with a valid certificate, so AnythingMCP Cloud reaches it with no extra setup.

LEXWARE_API_KEY.label: API key
LEXWARE_API_KEY.help: In Lexware Office (paid plan): Einstellungen → Erweiterungen → Öffentliche API → create a new access token. It is shown once.

tools.name: lexware_office_get_profile
tools.description: Read the connected company profile: company name, tax number, VAT id, the connection's user id and the small-business (Kleinunternehmer) flag. Fast call — use it to verify the token works.

tools.name: lexware_office_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers and vendors) with paging. Filter by role or by a free-text name fragment to find the party before reading or creating a document for them.

email.description: Exact e-mail address to filter by.

name.description: Name fragment; matches company name or last name.

customer.description: When true, only contacts that have the customer role.

vendor.description: When true, only contacts that have the vendor role.

tools.name: lexware_office_get_contact
tools.description: Read one contact by its Lexware id, including all addresses, the customer/vendor roles, contact persons, e-mail addresses and phone numbers.

id.description: Contact UUID as returned by lexware_office_list_contacts.

tools.name: lexware_office_list_vouchers
tools.description: Search the voucher list — the bookkeeping view across sales invoices, purchase invoices, credit notes, down payments and receipts. This is the tool for questions like 'what is still open' or 'what did we book in Q3'.

voucherType.description: Required by Lexware. Comma-separated list, or `any` for all types: salesinvoice, salescreditnote, purchaseinvoice, purchasecreditnote (bookkeeping vouchers: read one with lexware_office_get_voucher), invoice (lexware_office_get_invoice), creditnote (lexware_office_get_credit_note), quotation (lexware_office_get_quotation), downpaymentinvoice, orderconfirmation, deliverynote (lexware_office_get_sales_document).

voucherStatus.description: Required by Lexware. Comma-separated list, or `any`: draft, open, paid, paidoff, voided, transferred, sepadebit, accepted/rejected (quotations only), unchecked (bookkeeping vouchers only), overdue. `overdue` must be sent ALONE (voucherStatus=overdue), never combined with other statuses: Lexware answers 400 otherwise. Overdue vouchers are already included in `open`, so for 'everything unpaid' use `open,sepadebit,transferred`.

size.description: Page size, 1-250 (default 25). Lexware returns at most 10,000 results in total; narrow by date beyond that.

sort.description: voucherDate, voucherNumber, createdDate or updatedDate, optionally followed by ,ASC or ,DESC, e.g. voucherDate,DESC.

tools.name: lexware_office_get_invoice
tools.description: Read one sales invoice in full: header, addressee, every line item with net/gross and tax rate, the total amounts, the payment terms and the shipping date.

id.description: Invoice UUID. Only for voucher-list rows whose voucherType is `invoice`. For salesinvoice, purchaseinvoice, salescreditnote or purchasecreditnote use lexware_office_get_voucher; for downpaymentinvoice, orderconfirmation or deliverynote use lexware_office_get_sales_document. A wrong pairing answers 404.

tools.name: lexware_office_get_quotation
tools.description: Read one quotation (Angebot) in full, including its line items, totals, validity date and current status.

tools.name: lexware_office_get_credit_note
tools.description: Read one credit note (Rechnungskorrektur) in full: the invoice it corrects, its line items and its totals.

tools.name: lexware_office_get_voucher
tools.description: Read one bookkeeping voucher (voucher-list voucherType salesinvoice, salescreditnote, purchaseinvoice or purchasecreditnote): contact, voucher items grouped by tax rate, totals, due date and attached file ids.

id.description: Voucher UUID from lexware_office_list_vouchers whose voucherType is salesinvoice, salescreditnote, purchaseinvoice or purchasecreditnote.

tools.name: lexware_office_get_sales_document
tools.description: Read one down payment invoice, order confirmation, delivery note or dunning by id.

resource.description: downpaymentinvoice → down-payment-invoices, orderconfirmation → order-confirmations, deliverynote → delivery-notes.

tools.name: lexware_office_list_articles
tools.description: List articles (Artikel) from the product catalogue, optionally narrowed by article number or type, so an invoice line can reference a real product.

articleNumber.description: Exact article number to look up.

tools.name: lexware_office_list_countries
tools.description: List the country codes Lexware Office accepts in an address, with their tax classification (intra-community, third country). Useful before creating a contact with a foreign address.

tools.name: lexware_office_create_contact
tools.description: Create a new company contact with the customer and/or vendor role. Writes to the live company: check with lexware_office_list_contacts first that the party does not already exist.

roles.description: Roles as an object: {"customer":{}} (default), {"vendor":{}}, or both {"customer":{},"vendor":{}}.

billingAddress.description: Billing address: {"street":"Musterstr. 1","zip":"79098","city":"Freiburg","countryCode":"DE"}. countryCode (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) is required when an address is given. Omit for no address.

tools.name: lexware_office_create_invoice
tools.description: Create a sales invoice. With finalize=false it is saved as a draft that can still be edited or deleted; with finalize=true it is booked and becomes legally immutable under GoBD.

contactId.description: UUID of the customer the invoice is addressed to.

lineItems.description: Array of line items. Each: {type: 'custom', name, quantity, unitName, unitPrice: {currency: 'EUR', netAmount, taxRatePercentage}}.

finalize.description: When true the invoice is booked immediately instead of saved as a draft.

introduction.description: Text printed above the line items.

remark.description: Text printed below the line items, e.g. payment terms.

tools.name: lexware_office_get_delivery_note
tools.description: Read one delivery note (Lieferschein) in full: line items, status (draft or open), voucher date (= delivery date), address, shipping conditions and related vouchers. Find ids with lexware_office_list_vouchers and voucherType=deliverynote.

tools.name: lexware_office_get_delivery_note_pdf
tools.description: Download the PDF of a delivery note, returned as a file. Only for issued delivery notes (status open); a draft answers 409.

tools.name: lexware_office_get_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Download the PDF of a sales invoice, returned as a file. Only for finalized invoices (open, paid, voided); a draft answers 409.

tools.name: lexware_office_create_delivery_note
tools.description: Create a delivery note (Lieferschein) as a draft. It is not finalized: it can still be checked, edited or deleted in Lexware Office, and an invoice can be created from it there. Confirm the line items with the user before calling.

voucherDate.description: Delivery date in ISO 8601 with time and offset, e.g. 2026-10-13T00:00:00.000+02:00.

address.description: Recipient. Either {"contactId": "<uuid>"} for an existing contact, or {"name", "street", "zip", "city", "countryCode"} for a one-off address.

lineItems.description: Up to 300 items. Article: {"type": "material", "id": "<article uuid>", "name", "quantity", "unitName", "unitPrice": {"currency": "EUR", "netAmount", "taxRatePercentage"}}. Free item: type "custom" without id. Text line: {"type": "text", "name", "description"}.

introduction.description: Text above the line items, e.g. the order reference.

deliveryTerms.description: Delivery terms, e.g. Lieferung frei Haus.

tools.name: lexware_office_create_quotation_draft
tools.description: Create a quotation (Angebot) as a draft. It is not finalized or sent: it can still be edited or deleted in Lexware Office. Confirm the line items and validity date with the user before calling.

voucherDate.description: Quotation date in ISO 8601 with time and offset, e.g. 2026-10-22T00:00:00.000+02:00.

totalPrice.description: {"currency": "EUR"}; Lexware computes the totals. Optionally totalDiscountPercentage.

tools.name: lexware_office_get_article
tools.description: Read one article with its price and version. The version is required to update the article.

tools.name: lexware_office_create_article
tools.description: Create an article in the product catalogue. Check with lexware_office_list_articles (articleNumber) that it does not exist yet, and confirm the data with the user first.

type.description: PRODUCT for goods, SERVICE for work and fees.

price.description: {"netPrice": 10.0, "grossPrice": 11.9, "leadingPrice": "NET", "taxRate": 19}. leadingPrice NET or GROSS says which of the two prices is authoritative.

tools.name: lexware_office_update_article
tools.description: Replace an article completely (PUT): read it with lexware_office_get_article, keep every field, change only what the user asked for and send the current version. Fields left out are cleared. A stale version answers 409.

type.description: PRODUCT for goods, SERVICE for work and fees.
